hosting: romUrl values are same-repo relative paths today; remote URLs (e.g. Google Drive direct-download links) can be dropped in later with no code changes.

games.title: CONCENTRATION ROOM
games.desc: Card-matching memory game by Damian Yerrick (pinobatch). Clean NROM homebrew, plays perfectly in the browser.

games.title: ALLPADS
games.desc: Multi-controller diagnostic ROM by Damian Yerrick. Watch your button presses light up on screen — great for testing controls.

games.title: 240P TEST SUITE
games.desc: Artemio's 240p Test Suite, NES port by pinobatch. Pro-grade CRT/upscaler test patterns.

games.title: THWAITE
games.desc: Small-town anti-ballistic missile defense by pinobatch. Protect your town's buildings from incoming warheads — a beloved Missile Command-style homebrew.

games.title: ROBOT FINDS KITTEN
games.desc: Pinobatch's NES port of the classic zen-like 'robotfindskitten' for 2 players. Interact with objects until you find the kitten.

games.title: RHDE: FURNITURE FIGHT
games.desc: Home-decorating real-time strategy by pinobatch. Compete to have the most furniture in your room when the timer runs out.

games.title: ZAP RUDER
games.desc: Zapper test ROM with a 2-player air hockey simulator by pinobatch. Also works without a Zapper as a plain hockey game.

games.title: STALLAR
games.desc: Ludum Dare 50 space game by Wendel Scardua. Fly, land and explore in this compact homebrew adventure.

games.title: FILE FIXERS
games.desc: Computer-themed puzzle RPG by Wendel Scardua. Fix corrupted files in a playful retro-IT world.

games.title: SIGNOS
games.desc: Puzzle game by Wendel Scardua, made for Ludum Dare 59. Public-domain dedication (Unlicense).

games.title: 8-BIT TABLE TENNIS
games.desc: Two-player homebrew table tennis by Michael Billington. Classic Pong-style action with NES charm.

games.title: JEZNES
games.desc: JezzBall-style puzzle action by boingoing. Trap the bouncing atoms by building walls — an NES take on a classic.

games.title: GHOSTS 'N GRAVES
games.desc: Spooky platformer by Anthony Bongers. Climb, dodge ghosts and clear 40 screens across 5 levels — a full-featured homebrew adventure, public-domain dedicated (Unlicense).

games.title: NOVA THE SQUIRREL
games.desc: Full platformer by Nova Squirrel: 14 levels, a rabbit partner, multiple power-ups and rabbit-eared hats. GPL-3.0 with source available on GitHub.

games.title: PONG
games.desc: Clean NES Pong implementation by zorchenhimer (NTSC). Two-player paddle classic, BSD-licensed homebrew.

games.title: OPENNES SNAKE
games.desc: Snake on the NES by Sebastian Dine (openNES project). Zlib-licensed, grows and wraps its way to classic high-score chasing.
